title: Optimize quality gate execution without reducing trust
outOfScope: Deleting Trust Layer, SBOM, Provenance, Secret Scanning, vulnerability, installer, or Release Evidence checks.
Lowering coverage thresholds, converting failures to warnings, or treating cache hits as final evidence.
Changing Work Item Contract format except for an evidence-backed optional timing field.
Changing Branch Protection or other external GitHub governance settings without separate external evidence.
Publishing a version or changing release candidate metadata.

sources.reason: This Contract defines the implementation boundary for the user-authorized quality performance optimization.
Repository workflow requires Contract scope, fail-closed verification, PR lifecycle, and issue recording.
Current quality entry points and repeated gate ownership are defined here.
Current CI orchestration and the template-smoke quality/installer coupling are defined here.
User-provided development instruction describing performance goals, trust constraints, architecture, tests, documentation, and acceptance.
The execution plan is updated to insert this Work Item after the traceability correction and before release-blocking remediation continues.

riskAssessment.reason: Changing Make and CI orchestration can accidentally remove, duplicate, or race evidence-producing gates; every optimization must preserve fail-closed ownership and output isolation.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized inserting and executing this performance optimization Work Item after the current traceability Work Item.

preReviewWarnings: Review that duplicate work is removed only after ownership is proven, Release verification is preserved, and parallel groups have isolated outputs.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: quality-fast, quality-full, quality-release, and backward-compatible quality entry points have explicit semantics, with quality equivalent to quality-full.

The Make quality graph invokes each pytest, supply-chain, PR static, and Bandit evidence owner at most once; standalone debug targets remain callable and the workflow does not invoke those owners a second time.
Gate timing, per-gate logs, output digests, exit codes, scope, cache status, skipped reasons, slowest gate, and final decision are emitted as machine-readable and GitHub Summary evidence.
Quality scope defaults fail closed to Full, Release remains complete, cache never becomes final evidence, and parallel groups have no shared write conflicts.
Workflow responsibilities distinguish quality-fast, quality-full, installation-smoke, compatibility, and release-evidence without making PR Fast look like Release Full.

The named architecture, workflow ownership, scope, telemetry, cache, and parallel-safety test files exit 0; the English, Chinese, and Japanese quality-gate operation documents exist; and the Summary records either repeated before/after evidence for five scenario classes or a specific not-run reason for each missing class.
All required AI/project checks pass and the complete PR, merge, ai-close, branch-cleanup lifecycle is completed; no release is performed by this Work Item.

The instruction-to-plan-to-implementation-to-acceptance trace is bidirectionally checked for this Work Item and the global remediation plan before closure; every identified omission is recorded and corrected before proceeding.
guidelines: Preserve Evidence over Self-Declaration and fail closed on missing or conflicting telemetry.
Keep local and CI entry points aligned; GitHub Actions schedules gates but does not create a second quality fact source.
Never use parallel execution when gate output or Git worktree state is shared.
Document new public Make targets and machine-readable evidence formats.

intent.problem: The current make quality and GitHub Actions path repeats some checks, serializes independent heavy gates, hides installation work inside one long job, and lacks per-gate timing evidence. This produces long, poorly localized feedback without reducing the underlying verification burden.
constraints: Do not reduce trust, coverage threshold, Release verification, SBOM, Provenance, sensitive-value policy scanning, vulnerability checks, or fail-closed behavior.
Do not use make -j8 quality, unbounded timeouts, floating action/tool versions, or shared output files across parallel gates.
Keep quality backward compatible and preserve independent targets for focused debugging.
Use measured before/after evidence; do not claim performance improvement from a single run.
Do not change external Branch Protection settings in this repository Work Item.
intent.rationale: The safe optimization is to make each evidence-producing gate run once, isolate outputs, parallelize only independent groups, and expose timing so speed improvements remain reviewable and auditable.

rawUserRequest: 当前工单执行完成以后，插入一个工单，对应《AI Cockpit make quality 与 GitHub Actions 性能优化开发指示》。在不降低可信度、不削弱安全边界、不破坏本地开发体验的前提下，消除重复 Gate、分层 quality-fast/quality-full/quality-release、增加计时与可观测证据、进行安全并行和 Workflow 职责拆分；Release 验证必须保持完整。

declaredIntent.summary: Optimize quality gate execution without reducing evidence, trust, security boundaries, or Release verification.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: quality-full owns the full test and evidence graph without duplicate specialized pytest execution.
quality-fast is materially narrower but quality remains an alias for quality-full.
Parallel gate groups have isolated writes and deterministic conflict checks.
CI workflow ownership does not repeat quality sub-gates and keeps installation/release responsibilities distinct.
Gate timing and failure/timeout evidence are emitted without replacing the original exit result.
Release path retains complete SBOM, Provenance, Secret Scanning, vulnerability, installation, and release evidence checks.
